description: This is a Java source file defining the 'Category' entity class in a sales management system. It models category data including fields for descriptions, parent/child relationships, visibility, status, and associated merchant store, along with persistence annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Entity class representing a product category, including hierarchical relationships, descriptions, and various status flags.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the category's unique code.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the category's unique code.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the entity's identifier.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the entity's identifier.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information for this entity.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this entity.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of descriptions associated with this category.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of descriptions associated with this category.

methods.name: getCategoryImage
methods.description: Returns the image URL or path for the category.

methods.name: setCategoryImage
methods.description: Sets the image URL or path for the category.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of the category.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of the category.

methods.name: isCategoryStatus
methods.description: Returns whether the category is active.

methods.name: setCategoryStatus
methods.description: Sets the active status of the category.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the category is visible.

methods.name: setVisible
methods.description: Sets the visibility of the category.

methods.name: getDepth
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the category in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setDepth
methods.description: Sets the depth level of the category.

methods.name: getLineage
methods.description: Returns the lineage string representing the category's position path.

methods.name: setLineage
methods.description: Sets the lineage string for the category.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent category.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent category.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this category.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Associates this category with a merchant store.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of child categories.

methods.name: setCategories
methods.description: Sets the list of child categories.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a primary description for the category, if available.
